reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the furthest-from-zero rule used elsewhere.

duplication.why: No logic copied; the range rule is delegated to the helper.

placement.why: A named APIScheduleListEntity type sits with the API models, but the field is attached in the schedules-get handler rather than in the scheduleModel mapper beside it; this is acceptable since it applies only to the list.

scope.why: Only the handler, its type, a named API type and test expectations change.

maintainability.why: Small, typed and clearly scoped to the list endpoint.
